note: Site header -- renders: Booking.com logo, language/currency, sign in, register, and fixed service tabs (Stays, Flights, Packages, Car rentals, Attractions, Airport taxis)
Breadcrumb navigation -- renders: fixed platform section links (e.g., Stays, City, District)
Results header controls -- renders: fixed sort button label (e.g., Sort by: Recommended)
Map view toggle -- renders: fixed label (e.g., Show on map)
Filter sidebar frame -- renders: fixed section headings (e.g., Filters, Property Type, Facilities) and controls; specific filter values are masked by default
View switcher -- renders: fixed radio button labels (List, Grid)
Sort control -- renders: fixed sort option label (e.g., Sort by: Recommended)
Site footer -- renders: fixed platform navigation links (Support, Partners, About), legal links, and language/currency selectors
